name: DC barrel socket to 2-way screw terminal adapter, female, 5.5 x 2.1 mm
blurb: A DC socket with two screw clamps moulded on its back: the adapter plugs in at one end and the two wires of the build are clamped under the screws, with no soldering.

pins.note: The clamp marked + on the adapter: it goes to the centre pin of the socket. Read the + and - moulded next to the screws; which side they are on differs between makers, so do not go by this drawing. The marks assume a centre-positive adapter: measure across the two clamps with the adapter plugged in before connecting the build. Strip about 5 mm, push the wire in under the screw and tighten; nothing is soldered.
The clamp marked -: it goes to the sleeve of the socket. Ground on a centre-positive adapter.

search: DC barrel jack to screw terminal adapter female 5.5x2.1
female DC power adapter 2.1mm jack to screw terminal block

verify: No maker drawing exists for this adapter. The outline (35.3 x 13.5 x 11.3 mm) is what one shop, Addicore, states for its AD470; other shops give 36 x 14 mm and about 30 mm long, so measure yours. Not from any source, drawn for recognition only: where the two screws are (about 5 mm apart is typical for these), which side is +, and the height of the plug opening (put at the middle of the body). Measure the opening's position before a case wall depends on it; the port is the 5.5 mm barrel plus 2.5 mm for the plug's grip. Plug size 5.5 x 2.1 mm is as sold (Adafruit 368 calls it a 2.1 mm jack). No current or voltage rating is published by the shops opened; treat it as a low-current part and feel whether it gets warm above 2 A. The guide words each step as soldering: read it as 'clamp under the screw'. In a case the adapter is not fixed by anything: glue or strap it.
